stats: An Ancestrally Boosted Slam has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect, and an Ancestrally Boosted Strike will target 2 additional Enemies. Triggered Skills cannot be Ancestrally Boosted. Ancestrally Boosted Attacks count as being Empowered.
